note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a SLN 10-15; A06b SLN 10-15; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 10 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships (with major exceptions); a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Generally applicable provision), A01b (descent, born abroad: Dual citizenship restriction), A02a (birth in country: No provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: not by birth in the territory alone (provisions for foundlings and children otherwise stateless, modes A03a and A03b, aren't held by the form); by descent from either parent, a child born abroad on the limit the dataset states. The coding also records a dual-citizenship restriction on descent, which the form doesn't hold. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file. On 2026-11-03 the primary was read: Zakon o državljanstvu Republike Slovenije (ZDRS), Uradni list RS, št. 24/07 – uradno prečiščeno besedilo in 40/17, PISRS (Pravno-informacijski sistem RS), unofficial consolidated text, arts. 4, 5, 10, 17. Every figure the file holds now rests on it, and the dataset is no longer cited.

sources.said: 4. člen Po rodu pridobi državljanstvo Republike Slovenije otrok: 1. če sta ob njegovem rojstvu oče in mati državljana Republike Slovenije; 2. če je ob njegovem rojstvu eden od staršev državljan Republike Slovenije, otrok pa je rojen v Republiki Sloveniji; 3. če je ob njegovem rojstvu eden od staršev državljan Republike Slovenije, drugi pa je neznan ali je neznanega državljanstva ali je brez njega, otrok pa je rojen v tujini. ... 10. člen ... 2. da ima odpust iz dosedanjega državljanstva ali da izkaže, da ga bo dobila, če bo sprejeta v državljanstvo Republike Slovenije; 3. da dejansko živi v Sloveniji 10 let, od tega neprekinjeno zadnjih 5 let pred vložitvijo prošnje in ima urejen status tujca; ... Državljanstvo Republike Slovenije preneha: 1. z odpustom, 2. z odrekom, 3. z odvzemom, 4. po mednarodni pogodbi. ... 5. člen V tujini rojeni otrok, katerega eden od staršev je ob njegovem rojstvu državljan Republike Slovenije, drugi pa je tuj državljan, pridobi po rodu državljanstvo Republike Slovenije, če je do dopolnjenega 18. leta starosti priglašen kot državljan Republike Slovenije ali če se do dopolnjenega 18. leta starosti dejansko za stalno naseli v Republiki Sloveniji z roditeljem, ki je državljan Republike Slovenije. ... 6. člen Državljanstvo Republike Slovenije pridobi oseba, rojena v tujini, starejša od 18 let, ki do dopolnjenega 36. leta starosti da izjavo, da se priglaša kot državljan Republike Slovenije

atBirth.descentAbroad: Person is born abroad to a citizen and a parent unknown, of unknown citizenship or stateless; a child of one citizen and one foreign parent takes it if registered as a citizen, or settled permanently in Slovenia with the citizen parent, before 18; or a person born abroad declares for it between 18 and 36.
